title: An interest calculation with no tests at all
prompt: Write JUnit 5 tests for Interest.java in a new file InterestTest.java: the ordinary case, the boundaries (zero principal, zero days), and the two inputs it refuses. Use @DisplayName to say what each test asserts, and assertThrows for the refusals.
check: test -f InterestTest.java && codeonly InterestTest.java | grep -q 'import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test' && [ $(codeonly InterestTest.java | grep -c '@Test') -ge 4 ] && codeonly InterestTest.java | grep -q '@DisplayName' && codeonly InterestTest.java | grep -q 'assertThrows' && codeonly InterestTest.java | grep -q 'Interest'
